learning.why: teacher directly asked what's inside the bundle and linked it to 16, child now knows bundle means ten but still shaky on the digit meaning

end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one ten and extra ones.
Saanvi represented 13 and 14 as ten and some more.
They identified 17 as 1 ten and 7 ones, and 18 as 1 ten and 8 ones.
Practised teen-number digit order using 14 and 41.
Teach-back was not passed; bundle-counting confusion remained.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making teen numbers from one bundle of ten and loose ones. Counting on from ten helped them state 13 and 14, and they later explained that 14 is 1 ten and 4 ones, not 41. They still sometimes counted the bundle as one item when finding the total; at home, show one group of 10 blocks plus loose blocks and ask, “How many altogether?”
